info.title: Web Scraper Public API
info.description: Authenticate with `Authorization: Bearer <API_KEY>`. Create keys in the dashboard under API keys. Jobs are asynchronous: create, poll `GET /api/v1/jobs/{id}`, then read results. Traffic estimates: `POST /api/v1/traffic` with a domain, then `GET /api/v1/traffic/{domain}`. Errors always have the shape `{ error: { code, message, details?, requestId } }`.

post.description: Creates a scrape job. By default returns immediately (202) with status `queued`/`running`: poll `GET /jobs/{id}` until the status is terminal, then fetch `GET /jobs/{id}/results`. With `?wait=true` the request blocks until the page is done and returns 200 with the job and the page content inline (a failed scrape also returns 200, with `job.status = failed` and `job.error`).

project_id.description: Project to file the job under. Default: your oldest project ("Default project").

items.description: `branding` (scrape only) adds logo, favicon, brand colors and fonts; it loads the page in a browser and adds ~15-30 s.

timeout_ms.description: Per-page timeout. Default 30000; server max applies.

parameters.name: wait
parameters.description: Block until the scrape finishes (up to timeout_ms + 30s) and return the job with the page content inline (HTTP 200). If it doesn't finish in time you get the usual 202 + job to poll.

200.description: Returned by POST /scrape?wait=true when the job finished in time.

post.description: Starts an asynchronous crawl. Progress and page counts are reported on the job; pages appear under `/jobs/{id}/results` as they complete.

project_id.description: Project to file the job under. Default: your oldest project ("Default project").

items.description: `branding` (scrape only) adds logo, favicon, brand colors and fonts; it loads the page in a browser and adds ~15-30 s.

timeout_ms.description: Per-page timeout. Default 30000; server max applies.

max_depth.description: Link depth from the start URL. Default 3.

max_pages.description: Maximum pages to fetch. Default 200; server max applies (2000 by default).

include_patterns.description: Regexes matched against the URL path; only matching pages are crawled.

exclude_patterns.description: Regexes matched against the URL path; matching pages are skipped.

allowed_domain.description: Confine the crawl to this domain (start host or a parent of it). Default: start host.

allow_subdomains.description: Also follow links to subdomains of allowed_domain. Default false.

post.description: Starts an estimate for the domain, or returns the existing one if it is less than 7 days old (`refresh: true` forces new data). Returns 200 when the estimate is ready and 202 while it is being computed; poll `GET /traffic/{domain}`. With `?wait=true` the request blocks until it is ready (a new domain usually takes 10-30 s). Estimates are inferred from public signals, not measured traffic.

domain.description: A domain or URL. It is reduced to the registrable domain: `https://www.shop.example.co.uk/x` → `example.co.uk`.

refresh.description: Collect fresh data even if the domain was estimated in the last 7 days. Default false (reuse the recent estimate).

parameters.name: wait
parameters.description: Block until the estimate is ready (a new domain takes 10-30 s; at most 60 s) and return it with HTTP 200. If it is not ready in time you get 202 with `status: pending`; poll `GET /traffic/{domain}`.

parameters.name: details
parameters.description: Include `estimate.details`, the per-signal breakdown (diagnostic; its shape may change).

domain.description: Registrable domain the estimate is for

status.description: pending: being estimated; ready: `estimate` is set; failed: estimation failed and there is no earlier estimate

refreshing.description: A newer estimate is being computed; `estimate` is the previous one
